name: Alpidem

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in France, first in 1993 — for liver harm

summary: Alpidem was removed from the market in France starting in 1993 because of harm to the liver [3]. Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, the drug received a high risk score of 77 for the liver [M]. The same computer model gave the drug a low risk score of 44 for the heart [M].
